name: dsh-mobile-link
description: Phone pairing for DeepSeek Harness: three values (relay, room, key) bind a phone to this desktop, then the phone can read and continue the desktop's sessions from any network. Ships its own zero-dependency relay for NAT-to-NAT use. 三项值（中继 / 房间号 / 口令）把手机与电脑配对，手机可在任何网络下读取并续接电脑上的会话；内置零依赖中继。

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check relay/server.mjs
